I've added the file association configuration to your VS Code workspace settings. This will make VS Code treat `.mdx` files as Markdown files, which should enable the Markdown preview functionality.

A few things to note:
1. This change is workspace-specific (it only applies to this project)
2. You may need to reload VS Code for the changes to take effect
3. If you want this setting to apply globally (for all projects), you would need to add it to your user settings instead
